verdict.rationale: Parsec's pricing page lists "Virtual monitors" among its professional features, so the product does document a host-side virtual display. Nothing beyond that bare feature-list mention explains how it works or confirms the story's headless or covered-window scenarios. missing for 10: documentation of virtual display creation on the host, evidence that streams keep rendering when covered or when the machine runs headless, plan/platform availability details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
